scope: Production-seed boot of the 6.18.60-r0 kernel/ZFS pin on disposable state. Not the full Integration/qualification/run-zfs.py storage suite.

host.virtualization: Native Virtualization.framework; ad-hoc signed debug macus with Packaging/virtualization.entitlements

state.state_dir: fresh disposable directory outside the default ~/.tama/incus-mac (short path for the 103-byte Unix socket limit)
state.appliance: Integration/scripts/prepare-appliance.py from the signature-verified Alpine 3.24.2 cloud-init metal r0 raw image

second_boot.reboot_allowance: consumed once by the daemon's automatic restart

not_exercised: Integration/qualification/run-zfs.py lifecycle, snapshot, quota, growth, nested VM and space-exhaustion checks
TAMA_ZFS_EXPORT_OK marker, which is written to the guest's /var/log/tama-storage.log and not serial.log
macus start through the shipped catalog and launch agent
